text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Handmade clay and felt stop-motion miniature snowy mountain hot-spring inn, terracotta roof and rounded blue-gray walls, steam rising from an empty outdoor stone bath, soft white felt snow, amber windows, charming tactile craftsmanship, immersive small-scale scene without a display base, no toys shaped as characters.
